summary: Very short wooded kerb stretch, barely van-length, with homes 11-18 m away.

best_section.where: east kerb under the big trees, below the corner house with the red roof

drivers.seclusion: Wooded block behind the kerb; an unclassified building 11 m away and a dwelling 18 m along the same side.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street, cars parked nearby; the 9 m stretch only just fits a van.
drivers.convention: No signs on this stretch; cars park nearby on the street.

flags: Very short stretch, tight for a van
